desc.zh: 从挖去一段区间，推导有序边界的奇偶规则。
desc.en: Derive endpoint parity by cutting, joining, and querying real-number ranges.

complexity: O(k) time per update, O(log(k+1)) per query; O(k) space for k endpoints

concepts.name: 半开区间 / Half-open intervals
concepts.description: Left included, right excluded; removal preserves the right endpoint.

concepts.name: 边界奇偶性 / Endpoint parity
concepts.description: Strictly increasing alternating endpoints encode tracked real intervals.

concepts.name: 区间替换 / Interval replacement
concepts.description: Parity determines new boundaries when assigning coverage on a range.
